name: Common Ground
headline:
Care begins
with being heard.
intro: A welcoming place to ask questions, discuss your goals and understand the next step. Explore a calm, straightforward first-visit experience.
about_title: A conversation before a care plan.
about_body: Common Ground is a fictional chiropractic practice. This demonstration focuses on the patient experience: listening, explaining the assessment and making space for informed questions. No treatment results or practitioner credentials are represented.
split_title:
Understand the visit.
Ask what matters to you.
split_body: An actual clinician reviews history, performs an appropriate assessment and explains suitable options, alternatives and consent. This demonstration does not determine whether care is appropriate for anyone.
services: A new-patient visit would give you space to discuss goals, review the practice approach and ask about the assessment. Any clinical history belongs in an approved private intake process.
Ask what the visit includes, how long it takes and what fees apply.
A licensed clinician determines the appropriate assessment and discusses findings, suitable options and any need for referral. This demo offers no diagnosis or clinical recommendation.
Ask about options, alternatives and consent before deciding.
A real practice reviews progress and whether a proposed care plan remains appropriate. Visits and expectations are tailored by the clinician, without an outcome guarantee.
Discuss questions, scheduling and reassessment with the actual practice.
steps: Explore example dates and morning or afternoon preferences.
A real team confirms suitability, fees and the actual appointment.
Clinical information is collected only through the approved patient process.
faqs: Can I discuss symptoms through this form?
Please do not enter health information here. The demo only collects example contact and visit preferences locally.
Is this a diagnosis or treatment recommendation?
No. Only an appropriately licensed clinician can assess an individual and discuss suitable care.
Are fees or insurance coverage confirmed?
No. A real practice confirms fees, accepted coverage and payment arrangements before a visit.
Is a calendar selection a confirmed appointment?
No. The example calendar displays demonstration choices and checks no actual availability.
gallery_title: A calm setting for a clearer conversation.
note: Example visit preferences only. Do not provide symptoms, medical history or insurance identifiers. This demo offers no medical advice.
tool_title: Make the first visit feel familiar.
tool_intro: Explore a sample visit calendar and a three-step introduction. Dates are examples, not actual availability.
proof: Understand the practice approach before deciding.
Assessment and options belong in a conversation.
Clinical details use an approved private process.
